note:
The same head-dim-128 SDPA as `sdpa-hd128-softmax-v-mma`, with the CHUNKED value channel reading its streamed operand from a shared-memory slab instead of gmem-direct.

The chunk tier used to take no transport at all: `TileOp.stage_edges` excluded a chunked view, on the reading that the tier "takes its chunk off the TILE, so a transport spelling there would decide nothing". A `STAGE` never spelled that chunk — the resolver derives `bk_elems` from `Tile.bk`, the same number — so what the exclusion actually decided was that attention's value channel reads gmem-direct. On an RTX 5090 that costs 1.46x on the `attention.hd128.softmax_v` golden target: 16.1 us gmem-direct against 11.0 us at `d1/smem-tma`.

The ring is single-buffer by construction (`_chunk_warp_stage` hands back `depth=1`), so this pins `d1`.

let f32 v0 = 0.0883883461356163
for a0 in 0..8:
    for a1 in 0..512:
        for a2 in 0..512:
            for a3 in 0..128:
                in0 = load x0[0, a0, a1, a3]
                in1 = load x1[0, a0, a2, a3]
                f32 v1 = multiply(in0, in1)
                acc1 <- add(acc1, v1) over a3
            v2 = multiply(acc1, v0)
            acc0 <- maximum(acc0, v2) over a2
        for a2 in 0..512:
            for a5 in 0..128:
                in2 = load x0[0, a0, a1, a5]
                in3 = load x1[0, a0, a2, a5]
                f32 v3 = multiply(in2, in3)
                acc3 <- add(acc3, v3) over a5
            v4 = multiply(acc3, v0)
            v5 = subtract(v4, acc0)
            v6 = exp(v5)
            acc2 <- add(acc2, v6) over a2
        for a6 in 0..128:
            for a7 in 0..512:
                for a8 in 0..128:
                    in4 = load x0[0, a0, a1, a8]
                    in5 = load x1[0, a0, a7, a8]
                    f32 v7 = multiply(in4, in5)
                    acc5 <- add(acc5, v7) over a8
                v8 = multiply(acc5, v0)
                v9 = subtract(v8, acc0)
                v10 = exp(v9)
                v11 = divide(v10, acc2)
                in6 = load x2[0, a0, a7, a6]
                v12 = multiply(in6, v11)
                acc4 <- add(acc4, v12) over a7
            scaled_dot_product_attention[0, a0, a1, a6] = acc4
